name: Aegex 10 IS
statusNote: Discontinued by Aegex; its IECEx certificate has been cancelled.
summary: The Aegex 10 IS is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) 10.1-inch Windows tablet from Aegex, certified for Zone 1/21 under IECEx. Its operating system version isn't published. It has been discontinued; the Aegex 100M replaces it.

iecex.marking: Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db IP6X

certification.northAmerica: UL 913 Class I, II, III Div 1

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: charging or replacing the battery pack in explosive atmospheres is forbidden; follow the manual and label; replacing the SIM card in explosive atmospheres is forbidden.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 10 Pro or Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB (year not stated); Windows 8.1 also offered

specs.partNumbers: AEG-SKU-A10i7-432 (ATEXshop SKU for the Core i7 variant)

variants.name: Marking versions
variants.description: The certification covers more than one version: IECEx (issue 6, three options): Ex ib IIC T6 Gb or Ex ib IIC T4 Gb (Ta -10/-20 °C to +50 °C); Ex ib IIC T3 Gb (Ta -10/-20 °C to +55 °C) | IECEx (issue 6, three options): Ex ib IIIC T85°C Db IP6X or Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db IP6X (to +50 °C); Ex ib IIIC T200°C Db IP6X (to +55 °C)

unconfirmed.certification.northAmerica: From the maker's published information; we haven't seen the North American certificate.
unconfirmed.certification.division: From the maker's published information; we haven't seen the North American certificate.
unconfirmed.certification.tempClass: The certificate allows T6, T4 or T3 depending on the build; check the label on the device.
unconfirmed.os.edition: The maker doesn't state the edition year.
unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Microsoft ended Windows 10 Pro support on 14 October 2025. The maker doesn't state the edition; an LTSC edition would run longer.
unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.
